Cars Out, People In?

Many people think that banning cars from downtown is a good idea but I think it depends. In my opinion mid-sized cities should probably ban cars from some downtown streets, but not all of them.

First, downtowns are very crowded and there is a lot of traffic. When I drive downtown it takes forever to find parking and it is stressful. If there were no cars it would be less stressful to walk around. Also cars cause pollution which is bad for the environment and climate change is a big problem.

Second, a lot of cities in Europe have done this and it worked. I read that some cities have no cars in the middle and people like it. It makes the city look nicer and there are more cafes and places to sit outside.

However some people say that businesses will lose customers if people cant drive there. This is a good point because a lot of people live far away and dont have a bus. My family lives twenty minutes from downtown and there is no bus that goes there.

In conclusion, I think cities should try banning cars on a few streets first and see what happens. If it works they can do more streets. If you have questions about my essay you can email me at jalvarez7@stateu.edu.
